data.name: Maghazi
data.gender_notes: Maghazi is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'ghz', meaning 'to fight'. This name refers to a person involved in military campaigns or battles in the path of Allah. The name Maghazi carries the meaning “Battle Campaigns” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Maghazi usually hope their child will grow to embody battle campaigns and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name with a noble and spiritual meaning, reminding us of the sacrifices made by our prophets and early Muslims.
data.etymology: Maghazi belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Battle Campaigns.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Maghazi total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_arabic.name: مغازي
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مشتق من غازي، يعني المحارب أو المقاتل في سبيل الله
in_arabic.long_meaning: مغازي هو اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي، مشتق من كلمة 'غازي' التي تعني المحارب أو المقاتل في سبيل الله. يستخدم هذا الاسم للدلالة على الشخص الذي يقاتل في سبيل الدفاع عن الدين أو الوطن. وردت مشتقات هذا الاسم في القرآن الكريم في سياق الحديث عن الجهاد في سبيل الله. يعتبر اسم مغازي ذا أهمية كبيرة في التراث الإسلامي، حيث أنه يعكس القيم النبيلة من الشجاعة والكرامة.

in_urdu.name: مغازی
in_urdu.meaning: غازی کا مشتق، یعنی اللہ کی راہ میں لڑنے والا یا مجاہد
in_urdu.long_meaning: مغازی ایک مذکر اسم ہے جو عربی زبان سے ماخوذ ہے۔ یہ 'غازی' سے مشتق ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے اللہ کی راہ میں لڑنے والا یا مجاہد۔ یہ نام ان شخصیات کو مخاطب کرنے کے لئے استعمال کیا جاتا ہے جو دین یا ملک کی دفاع کے لئے لڑتے ہیں۔ قرآن کریم میں اس کے مشتقات کا ذکر مجاہدین کے سیاق میں کیا گیا ہے۔ مغازی نام اسلامی تراث میں خاصی اہمیت رکھتا ہے کیونکہ یہ بہادری اور شرافت جیسی بلند اقدار کی عکاسی کرتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: मगाज़ी
in_hindi.meaning: मुस्लिम परंपरा में, मगाज़ी का अर्थ है अल्लाह के लिए लड़ने वाला
in_hindi.long_meaning: मगाज़ी एक पुरुषार्थी नाम है जिसकी उत्पत्ति अरबी भाषा में हुई है। यह 'ग़ाज़ी' से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है अल्लाह के लिए लड़ने वाला या जिहाद करने वाला। इस नाम का उपयोग उन व्यक्तियों को संबोधित करने के लिए किया जाता है जो धर्म या देश की रक्षा के लिए लड़ते हैं। कुरआन में इसके व्युत्पन्न का उल्लेख जिहाद के संदर्भ में किया गया है। मगाज़ी नाम इस्लामी परंपरा में बहुत महत्व रखता है, क्योंकि यह वीरता और शौर्य जैसे उच्च मूल्यों को दर्शाता है।

in_pashto.name: مغازي
in_pashto.meaning: د غازي څخه مشتق شوی، يعنې د الله په لاره کې جنګیالی
in_pashto.long_meaning: مغازي یو مذکر نوم دی چی د عربي ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی دی. دا د 'غازي' څخه مشتق شوی دی، چی معنی یې د الله په لاره کې جنګیالی یا مجاهد دی. دا نوم د هغو کسانو لپاره کارول کیږي چی د دین یا هیواد د دفاع لپاره جنګیږي. په قرآن کریم کې د هغې مشتقات د مجاهدینو په سیاق کې ذکر شوي دي. مغازي نوم په اسلامي میراث کې ډیر اهمیت لري، ځکه چی دا د زړورتیا او کرامت لوړ ارزښتونه منعکس کوي.

in_english.name: Maghazi
in_english.meaning: Derived from Ghazi, meaning warrior or fighter in the way of Allah
in_english.long_meaning: Maghazi is a masculine given name derived from the Arabic root 'Ghayn-Zay', meaning a warrior or fighter in the way of Allah. The term 'Ghazi' is used to describe a person who fights in the cause of Allah or for defending the faith. References to similar terms can be found in the Quran in the context of jihad. The name Maghazi holds significant importance in Islamic tradition, reflecting noble values such as bravery and dignity. It symbolizes the spirit of jihad and the pursuit of righteousness.

historical_references.reference: The Maghazi is a collection of authentic Hadiths narrated by Imam Al-Bukhari during his travels (Safar) in various Arabian cities and regions in the 9th century CE, recording the sayings and actions of the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) and his companions (Sahabah). These Hadiths are an essential source of Islamic law and guidance.
historical_references.context: Compilation of authentic Hadiths during travels in Arabian cities and regions

historical_references.reference: The Maghazi is also the name given to a series of military campaigns led by Muslim armies under the caliph Umar ibn Al-Khattab in the 7th century CE against the Byzantine Empire and the Sassanid Empire. These campaigns expanded the Islamic state from the Arabian Peninsula to Syria, Iraq, and Egypt.
historical_references.context: Military campaigns led by Muslim armies under Caliph Umar ibn Al-Khattab

modern_usage.modern_context: The term 'Maghazi' refers to the military campaigns conducted by the early Muslim armies under the leadership of Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) and his successors during the formative period of Islamic history. This period witnessed numerous military expeditions, largely in defense of the nascent Islamic state and for the expansion of its territory. Today, the study of Maghazi is a significant area of research in various academic disciplines, including history, archaeology, and Islamic studies. Scholars often use online platforms such as Academia.edu, ResearchGate, and Google Scholar to access and share their research on this topic. The modern context of Maghazi therefore includes not only the historical significance of these campaigns, but also their contemporary relevance as subjects of academic study and exploration.
